market_question: Will Mirra Andreeva win the 2026 Women’s French Open?
reasoning: Mirra Andreeva is a promising young player but as of now she hasn't won a WTA title nor shown elite clay results. The chance she wins the 2026 French Open at age 19 against a field that will still likely include dominant clay champions like Iga Swiatek is realistically around 1–2%, well below the market-implied 6.7%. The 5.2% edge makes ‘No’ the value side.
evidence_points: Andreeva has no WTA singles titles yet and her best Grand Slam result is a fourth round appearance.
Historical French Open winners at age ≤19 are extremely rare and usually come after prior elite clay performances (e.g., Swiatek 2020).
The women’s field includes multiple established clay-court elites who will still be prime contenders in 2026.
Probability models for a single non-top-5 player winning a Grand Slam typically fall below 2%.
sources_consulted: WTA player profiles and rankings (general knowledge)
